fusions.name: White-Tail Flash
fusions.desc: A flash of your white tail that deals 12 light damage to the first enemy it meets within 5 tiles and stuns it for 1 second. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: False Alarm
fusions.desc: A sharp bark that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Startled Bound
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% and your dodge chance by 8% for 6 seconds, and carries you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: First to Flinch
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you regain 12 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
